residual_risks: POST /uploads/presign with folder: "workouts" is now a hard failure in apps/api/src/uploads/uploads.controller.ts, so any stale non-web caller still using the legacy compatibility path will break immediately.

Contract coverage is still unit-level: uploads.controller.spec.ts, workouts.controller.spec.ts, and use-workout-entry.test.tsx cover the boundary shift, but there is no end-to-end check for the browser upload flow against the API/storage adapter.
